data.gender_notes: Kanhiya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kanhiya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kanh’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Iya’ meaning ‘little one’ or ‘grace’. This name signifies the divine presence and grace of God in the life of the child. The name Kanhiya carries the meaning “God's grace, little one” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanhiya usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
